description: This file contains utility functions for setting up transport-specific FastAPI routes, handling WebRTC/WebSocket connections, SDP manipulation, transport detection, and telephony transport creation within a WebRTC/telephony application. It includes functions for parsing WebSocket messages, detecting transport types, managing transport parameters, and capturing participant video streams.

methods.name: _detect_transport_type_from_message
methods.description: Attempts to auto-detect the transport type based on WebSocket message structure by inspecting message fields for known provider signatures.

methods.name: parse_telephony_websocket
methods.description: Reads and parses initial WebSocket messages to determine the telephony provider type and extract provider-specific call data.

methods.name: get_transport_client_id
methods.description: Retrieves a client identifier from a transport-specific client object, supporting different transport types.

methods.name: maybe_capture_participant_camera
methods.description: Attempts to capture participant camera video if the transport supports it, based on transport type.

methods.name: maybe_capture_participant_screen
methods.description: Attempts to capture participant screen video if the transport supports it, based on transport type.

methods.name: smallwebrtc_sdp_munging
methods.description: Modifies SDP text for SmallWebRTC compatibility by cleaning up fingerprints and ICE candidates.

methods.name: create_transport
methods.description: Creates and configures a transport instance based on runner arguments and transport parameters, supporting multiple transport types including daily, webrtc, and telephony providers.
